reviews.title: Best monitor!
reviews.comment: Most valuable purchase for a monitor you can get. Crisp graphics, easy to set up, quick delivery (might differ), SUPER affordable, and comes from a reputable brand. For $75, 144 hertz is a steal. The size is perfect for me (my old monitor was a 27-inch and it was a little too big). It comes packaged very neatly and took me 10 minutes to get running. It comes with all the cords and the stand. Super happy about this purchase and will look for more products from msi!
reviews.author: Andrian

reviews.title: Perfect monitor for 12v EmComm Powered Ham Stations
reviews.comment: I wanted a monitor that could run on 12v natively so I could power it using my battery-backed ham solar power backup system. I thought the picture wuality might be a compromise for the 12v niche use case, but it turns out the picture quality is beautiful. Very good contrast with deep black background quality. Great value for ham radio operators
reviews.author: Bryan A

reviews.title: Crystal Clear Screens!
reviews.comment: I purchased a pair of these to replace my old monitors and I just could not be any happier. Plus, they match the MSI computer I purchased last year perfectly! I like MSI products.. Good quality stuff for sure! Delivery was fast and problem free and the package was placed right at my door making it super easy for to retrieve (I am disabled). Setup was a breeze! The screens are crystal clear and so much better on my eyes too. I don't play games so I can't comment on that aspect but for general every use, yes yes and yes they are very good!
reviews.author: ERROR 505

reviews.title: Perfect Monitor
reviews.comment: Great lil monitor, only thing missing were speakers but at the price you can’t be mad at that. Highly recommend, great picture quality and the higher refresh rate and HDR are a treat for something so affordable
reviews.author: Louis

reviews.title: Almost perfect
reviews.comment: Good monitor, light weight. Doesn’t handle ALL games the best but does the job. If you’re just looking to spend on a monitor under $100, this is a great choice
